drums.description: Stomp and clap percussion ensemble, The arrangement consists of layered handclaps, rhythmic foot stomps, and a resonant wood block or rimshot accent, The piece maintains a steady 4/4 time signature at 124 BPM, The rhythm is built on a syncopated pattern where the stomps emphasize the downbeats while the claps provide a sharp, dry backbeat on 2 and 4, occasionally shifting into eighth-note subdivisions, A high-pitched percussive click or wood block enters periodically to accent the off-beats, The mix is dry with minimal artificial reverb, emphasizing the natural room acoustics and the transient snap of the claps Publish
